preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) and i >= 0 for i in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(d[x][i] < d[x][j] for x in range(n) for i in range(j) for j in range(len(d[x])) if i < j)
postconditions.description: For each vertex x, the depth array d[x] is strictly increasing up to the dominant index.

postconditions.expression: all(d[x][i] <= d[x][j] for x in range(n) for i in range(j) for j in range(len(d[x])) if i > j)
postconditions.description: For each vertex x, the depth array d[x] is non-increasing after the dominant index.
